# wallet — commands

<!-- generated by tools/gen-docs.mjs from upstream onchainos 4.6.3; do not edit -->
Agentic wallet: accounts, balances, transfers, UTXOs, contract calls, and history. Required flags are in the signature; `ocl wallet <cmd> --help` prints the full upstream help.

Contents (30): login · add · switch · status · addresses · receive · logout · chains · geoblock · balance · funding-check · send · history · inscription create · inscription status · utxo user-ignored · utxo unavailable · utxo available · utxo brc20-transferable · utxo unlock · utxo lock · utxo reclaim · sign-message · report-plugin-info · contract-call · gas-station update-default-token · gas-station enable · gas-station disable · gas-station status · gas-station setup

### wallet login
Start social login (Google / Apple / Email via browser)
`ocl wallet login [options]`
- `--phase <PHASE>` — Login phase (default init; init|open|poll)
- `--url <URL>` — Login URL to open — required for `--phase open`
- `--session-id <SESSION_ID>` — Auth session id to poll — used by `--phase poll`

### wallet add
Add a wallet account
`ocl wallet add`

### wallet switch
Switch the active wallet account
`ocl wallet switch <ACCOUNT_ID>`
- `ACCOUNT_ID` — Account ID to switch to

### wallet status
Show login and active-account status
`ocl wallet status [options]`
- `--include-subscriptions`

### wallet addresses
Show wallet addresses
`ocl wallet addresses [options]`
- `--chain <CHAIN>` — Chain name or ID

### wallet receive
Show the active account's receive address and QR
`ocl wallet receive [options]`
- `--chain <CHAIN>` — Target chain name or ID
- `--token <TOKEN>` — Token name, symbol, or full contract address
- `--cursor <CURSOR>` — Opaque cursor returned by the previous --token page

### wallet logout
Logout and clear all stored credentials
`ocl wallet logout`

### wallet chains
List all supported chains (cached locally, refreshes every 10 minutes)
`ocl wallet chains`

### wallet geoblock
Check Polymarket geoblock status
`ocl wallet geoblock`

### wallet balance
Query wallet balances
`ocl wallet balance [options]`
- `--all` — Query all accounts' assets
- `--chain <CHAIN>` — Chain name or ID
- `--token-address <TOKEN_ADDRESS>` — Query one token
- `--force` — Force refresh: bypass all caches and re-fetch wallet accounts + balances from the API

### wallet funding-check
Re-query one asset after a funding prompt and return a normalized balance/shortfall decision for the shared funding flow
`ocl wallet funding-check --chain <CHAIN> --required <REQUIRED> --asset <ASSET> [options]`
- `--token-address <TOKEN_ADDRESS>` — Token contract address

### wallet send
Send a native or token transfer
`ocl wallet send --recipient <RECIPIENT> --chain <CHAIN> [options]`
- `--amt <AMT>` — Amount in minimal units — whole number, no decimals (e.g. "100000000000000000" for 0.1 ETH)
- `--readable-amount <READABLE_AMOUNT>` — Human-readable amount (e.g. "1.5" for 1.5 USDC)
- `--from <FROM>` — Sender address (optional — defaults to selectedAccountId)
- `--contract-token <CONTRACT_TOKEN>` — Token identifier for non-native transfers: ERC-20/SPL address, SUI Coin Type, or btc-brc20-<ticker>
- `--brc20-outpoint <BRC20_OUTPOINT>` (repeatable) — Transferable BRC-20 inscription UTXO (`txHash:voutIndex`)
- `--fee-rate <FEE_RATE>` — Bitcoin fee rate in sat/vB
- `--force` — Run only after this exact command returned confirming and the user explicitly confirmed
- `--gas-token-address <GAS_TOKEN_ADDRESS>` — Gas token contract address for Gas Station payment (from tokenList)
- `--relayer-id <RELAYER_ID>` — Relayer ID for Gas Station (from tokenList)
- `--enable-gas-station` — Enable Gas Station (first-time activation, sets gasTokenAddress as default)

### wallet history
Query transaction history or one transaction/order detail
`ocl wallet history [options]`
- `--account-id <ACCOUNT_ID>` — Account ID
- `--chain <CHAIN>` — Chain name or ID (e.g. "ethereum" or "1", "solana" or "501")
- `--address <ADDRESS>` — Address (optional; passed to detail query if provided)
- `--begin <BEGIN>` — List-mode start time in Unix milliseconds
- `--end <END>` — List-mode end time in Unix milliseconds
- `--cursor <CURSOR>` — List-mode continuation cursor returned by the previous response
- `--limit <LIMIT>` — List-mode page size
- `--order-id <ORDER_ID>` — Order ID — when present, queries /order/detail by orderId
- `--tx-hash <TX_HASH>` — Transaction hash — when present, queries /order/detail by txHash
- `--uop-hash <UOP_HASH>` — User operation hash — when present, queries /order/detail by uopHash

### wallet inscription create
Create an asynchronous BRC-20 transfer inscription
`ocl wallet inscription create --chain <CHAIN> --token-address <TOKEN_ADDRESS> --readable-amount <READABLE_AMOUNT> [options]`
- `--from <FROM>`
- `--operation-token <OPERATION_TOKEN>`
- `--fee-rate <FEE_RATE>` — Bitcoin fee rate in sat/vB
- `--force` — Run only after this exact creation command returned confirming and the user explicitly confirmed

### wallet inscription status
Query BRC-20 transfer-inscription status by transaction hash or order ID
`ocl wallet inscription status --chain <CHAIN> [options]`
- `--tx-hash <TX_HASH>`
- `--order-id <ORDER_ID>`

### wallet utxo user-ignored
Query user-ignored Bitcoin UTXOs after asset protection is removed
`ocl wallet utxo user-ignored --chain <CHAIN>`

### wallet utxo unavailable
Query unavailable or locked Bitcoin UTXOs grouped by the current service reason
`ocl wallet utxo unavailable --chain <CHAIN>`

### wallet utxo available
Query currently available Bitcoin UTXOs and total spendable BTC in sats
`ocl wallet utxo available --chain <CHAIN>`

### wallet utxo brc20-transferable
Query transferable inscription UTXOs for one BRC-20 token
`ocl wallet utxo brc20-transferable --chain <CHAIN> --token-address <TOKEN_ADDRESS> [options]`
- `--readable-amount <READABLE_AMOUNT>` — Human-readable target amount used to find up to three exact UTXO combinations

### wallet utxo unlock
Remove asset protection from one or all currently protected UTXOs
`ocl wallet utxo unlock --chain <CHAIN> [options]`
- `--outpoint <OUTPOINT>` (repeatable) — Repeat for selected outpoints in txHash:voutIndex form
- `--all` — Remove protection from every currently protected UTXO
- `--operation-token <OPERATION_TOKEN>`
- `--force` — Run only after this exact command returned confirming and the user explicitly confirmed

### wallet utxo lock
Restore asset protection for one or all user-ignored UTXOs
`ocl wallet utxo lock --chain <CHAIN> [options]`
- `--outpoint <OUTPOINT>` (repeatable)
- `--all`
- `--operation-token <OPERATION_TOKEN>`
- `--force`

### wallet utxo reclaim
Close mempool-removed transactions and reclaim their still-unspent inputs
`ocl wallet utxo reclaim --chain <CHAIN> --tx-hash <TX_HASH> [options]`
- `--force`

### wallet sign-message
Sign a message (personalSign for EVM & Solana, EIP-712 for EVM only)
`ocl wallet sign-message --message <MESSAGE> --chain <CHAIN> --from <FROM> [options]`
- `--type <TYPE>` — Signing type: "personal" (default) or "eip712" (default personal)
- `--force` — Force execution: skip confirmation prompts from the backend

### wallet report-plugin-info
Report plugin info
`ocl wallet report-plugin-info --plugin-parameter <PLUGIN_PARAMETER>`

### wallet contract-call
Call a smart contract
`ocl wallet contract-call --chain <CHAIN> [options]`
- `--to <TO>` — Contract or program address
- `--amt <AMT>` — Native token amount in minimal units — whole number, no decimals (default "0") (default 0)
- `--input-data <INPUT_DATA>` — EVM call data (hex-encoded, e.g. "0xa9059cbb...")
- `--unsigned-tx <UNSIGNED_TX>` — Solana unsigned transaction data (base58)
- `--sui-tx-bytes <SUI_TX_BYTES>` — SUI pre-built TransactionData / PTB (base64 BCS)
- `--gas-limit <GAS_LIMIT>` — Gas limit override (EVM only)
- `--from <FROM>` — Sender address (optional — defaults to selectedAccountId)
- `--aa-dex-token-addr <AA_DEX_TOKEN_ADDR>` — AA DEX token contract address (optional)
- `--aa-dex-token-amount <AA_DEX_TOKEN_AMOUNT>` — AA DEX token amount (optional)
- `--mev-protection` — Enable MEV protection (supported on Ethereum, BSC, Base, Solana)
- `--jito-unsigned-tx <JITO_UNSIGNED_TX>` — Jito unsigned transaction data for Solana MEV protection (required when --mev-protection is used on Solana)
- `--force` — Run only after this exact command returned confirming and the user explicitly confirmed
- `--gas-token-address <GAS_TOKEN_ADDRESS>` — Gas token contract address for Gas Station payment (from tokenList)
- `--relayer-id <RELAYER_ID>` — Relayer ID for Gas Station (from tokenList)
- `--enable-gas-station` — Enable Gas Station (first-time activation or re-enable, sets gasTokenAddress as default)
- `--biz-type <BIZ_TYPE>` — Transaction category for broadcast (agentBizType), e.g. "dex", "defi", "dapp"
- `--strategy <STRATEGY>` — Strategy / skill name used for this call (agentSkillName)

### wallet gas-station update-default-token
Update the default Gas Token for a chain
`ocl wallet gas-station update-default-token --chain <CHAIN> --gas-token-address <GAS_TOKEN_ADDRESS>`

### wallet gas-station enable
Enable Gas Station for a chain (DB flag only)
`ocl wallet gas-station enable --chain <CHAIN>`

### wallet gas-station disable
Disable Gas Station for a chain (DB flag only, no on-chain action)
`ocl wallet gas-station disable --chain <CHAIN>`

### wallet gas-station status
Read-only Gas Station readiness check on a chain
`ocl wallet gas-station status --chain <CHAIN> [options]`
- `--from <FROM>` — Sender address (optional — defaults to selectedAccountId)

### wallet gas-station setup
Standalone Gas Station first-time activation
`ocl wallet gas-station setup --chain <CHAIN> --gas-token-address <GAS_TOKEN_ADDRESS> --relayer-id <RELAYER_ID> [options]`
- `--from <FROM>` — Sender address (optional — defaults to selectedAccountId)
